description: AC stopped blowing cold air 9 days ago. Apartment is 88F inside. Reported by text on Sept 11 and Sept 14, no response.

classification.rationale: Loss of cooling during extreme heat affects the habitability of the unit.
classification.factual_description: The air conditioning unit in my apartment stopped producing cold air on September 11. The indoor temperature has been measured at 88 degrees Fahrenheit. I notified the management office by text message on September 11 and again on September 14 and have not received a response. The condition remains uncorrected.
